channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ja Morant | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ja Morant from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Roddy on Ja Morant
item.description:
David Roddy:

“First and foremost, I think the media has Ja Morant, his image, completely wrong. He's a great leader. He was vocal from the jump. He took all of our rookies under his wing, my first year. Andhe just has an amazing heart. People don't really, people misunderstand him a lot. It's very easy just because, you know, he's young, he makes mistakes just like everybody else, but people are trying to bash it over his head continually.”

David Roddy on Ja Morant, Oct 13, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Ja Morant
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Damian Lillard on Ja Morant:

“Being around him, he's a good dude. And I consider myself a pretty good judge of character. He's easy to be around. When we're hooping, the talent is obvious.”

Damian Lillard on Ja Morant, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Ja Morant, Deni Avdija
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Damian Lillard:

“If I'm advancing the ball and I'm kicking it ahead to Ja Morant or Deni Avdija, I feel good about that. And if they're advancing the ball and kick it out to me for a three, they should feel pretty good about that, too.”

Damian Lillard on Ja Morant, Deni Avdija, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Ja Morant
item.description:
Ramona Shelburne:Blazers GM Joe Cronin on the acquisition of Ja Morant:

“Just straight belief in Ja. Our view of Ja as still a very high-level player.…I’m sure there will be questions about fit, but we’re very focused on talent.”

Joe Cronin on Ja Morant, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter @ramonashelburne.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Ja Morant
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Joe Cronin on Ja Morant's off-court concerns:

“Who Ja is as a person doesn't concern us. We've studied him for a long time and we're very confident that he's a good guy. I also have a lot of faith in our environment and our ability to support him.”

Joe Cronin on Ja Morant, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Ja Morant
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Jrue Holiday on Ja Morant:

“We have so many multi-faceted guards that can do different things. ... Ja can play. I understand why we traded for him. He's a fast-paced player but he also knows how to change speeds and get everybody involved.”

Jrue Holiday on Ja Morant, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Micah Nori on Ja Morant
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Micah Nori on Ja Morant:

“He's got a chance to win again. And he's got a chance to win with leaders he admires and looks up to,and will allow him to be the best version of Ja he can be.”

Micah Nori on Ja Morant, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Micah Nori on Ja Morant
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Micah Nori on guard logjam:

“You have guys who are willing passers. You're not adding Ja (Morant) wanting to shoot 22 or 24 times a game. The league is going a lot smaller and positionless. I think it's a good problem to have.”

Micah Nori on Ja Morant, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Desmond Bane on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant
item.description:
MrBuckBuck: Desmond Bane on Ja Morant and Jaren Jackson Jr. being at his game tonight:

“It’s special. Those are guys that I spent 5 years with… It’s a friendship that’ll last forever… I’m thankful that they pulled up to support.”

Desmond Bane on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Apr 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Zach Kleiman on Ja Morant
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Zach Kleiman on Ja Morant:

“I think everyone is on the same page as much as they can be. I’m not going to speculate on potential transactions.”

Zach Kleiman on Ja Morant, Apr 13, 2026. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Draymond Green on Ja Morant
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“And sometimes when you think about reviving a career, etc., sometimes guys just need a fresh start. And I don’t know that Ja feels he need a fresh start. I don’t know uh the sentiment around that. But maybe he do. But I think nonetheless,if he does get a fresh start, I think we’ll see the Ja Morant that we’ve grown accustomed to seeing.”

Draymond Green on Ja Morant, Jan 13, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Pat Riley, Erik Spoelstra, Ja Morant
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“The organizations that whisper behind their coaches’ backs and don’t have their backs? Their teams are trash. So again,I feel like this relationship has run its course. I do think it’s time for Ja Morant and the Memphis Grizzlies to part ways. And I think there’s only one option for Ja — only one direction he needs to go: he needs that Erik Spoelstra–Pat Riley–Miami Heat type of structure.”

Kendrick Perkins on Pat Riley, Erik Spoelstra, Ja Morant, Nov 5, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Marc Spears on Ja Morant
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Marc Spears on what people around the league are saying about Ja Morant:

“Four of the execs I talked to today say they really have no interest in trading for him. One said it was because it's a combo of contract and off the court issues. Another suggested that if Ja is traded it'll probably be a problem star for a problem star. I asked one current NBA coach if he would like to coach Ja Morant and he said I'm not sure I'd want to”

Marc Spears on Ja Morant, Nov 4, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Stockton on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Ja Morant
item.description:
“And Luka might be up there to break LeBron’s 40,000 because he’s starting so early in the game so, that’s one. Joker for scoring, but not assists. You know if Ja Morant would put his mind to it and just become an assist maker, he could easily do it, you know? Because he has the time and he has the experience — he can score, but he can also make the passes as well. I like Kyrie Irving too.”

John Stockton on LeBron James, Kyrie Irving, Ja Morant, Apr 30, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Scotty Pippen Jr on Ja Morant
item.description:
Scotty Pippen Jr. on Ja Morant's injury impact:

“I think we all felt pretty well. You know, we were winning at home. Obviously, in the playoffs, I feel like home court advantage is one of the biggest things. In OKC, obviously, we had a 50-point loss — that was crazy. But second game, we came and got better. The third game, we were up, Ja goes down. And then even the fourth game, we still competed. So it could go either way, I feel like, if he doesn’t go out.”

Scotty Pippen Jr on Ja Morant, Apr 29, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Ja Morant, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Magic Johnson:

“Anthony Edwards is the most exciting player to watch in the NBA. If you look at him and you look at Ja Morant, they’re probably the two. And then, of course, Kyrie. Those three can just put on a show. You watch them, and you’re like, ‘Whoo!’ But when Anthony Edwards said this summer, ‘Oh, nobody’s ever been as athletic as me in this league. Nobody could jump like me,’ I was like, ‘Whoa, whoa, whoa. What are you talking about?’”

Magic Johnson on Ja Morant, Anthony Edwards, Mar 17, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Yuki Kawamura on Ja Morant
item.description:
Yuki Kawamura on Ja Morant's daughter Kaari cheering for him courtside:

“I love it. She brings the energy every G League game and NBA game. We couldn't win for her tonight. I was disappointed in the result.”

Yuki Kawamura on Ja Morant, Mar 12, 2025. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Yuki Kawamura on Ja Morant
item.description:
Yuki Kawamura on his relationship with Ja Morant:

“I don’t know how to make relationship with him, but he’s so nice guy and he’s my great friend. Great teammate. My mentor.”

Yuki Kawamura on Ja Morant, Mar 2, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: GG Jackson on Ja Morant
item.description:
GG Jackson on Ja Morant's hops:

“I’ll compare it to when you see Mario jump and there’s that little poof of an air cloud under him. Swear to God, sometimes you see a little poof of a cloud under Ja. Every day in practice, like the past two training camps I’ve been part of, it’s something new. Like, every single day.”

GG Jackson on Ja Morant, Jan 28, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Ja Morant
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on his interaction with Ja Morant:

“I will never speak to other players and I don’t want them to speak to me… I don’t want any interaction. I think it’s disrespectful and it’s not part of the game… Play with respect for the game.”

Jordi Fernandez on Ja Morant, Dec 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Ja Morant
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on what Ja Morant said at halftime:

“I didn't say anything to him. I don't speak to other players unless I know them. And that's something the officials have to judge... Having respect for the game, I will all only talk to the other, team's coach if I know him”

Jordi Fernandez on Ja Morant, Dec 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Desmond Bane
item.description:
Drew Hill:Darko Rajakovic on if it’s any easier to scout this game:

“It’s never easy to scout a team that has Ja Morant, Desmond Bane and Jaren Jackson Jr.”

Darko Rajakovic on Jaren Jackson Jr, Ja Morant, Desmond Bane, Jan 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama on Ja Morant
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Wemby on Morant:

“Of course, a good player. Very, very small, so it's hard to catch up on him, and very fast. Yeah, it's just another great player that I see every night now in the NBA.Everyone's got a franchise player like this who's causing problems.”

Victor Wembanyama on Ja Morant, Jan 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Tee Morant on Ja Morant
item.description:
Tee Morant:

“Ja Morant is going to be the typical guy, a family guy that is going to be an inspiration to a lot, especially in South Carolina, Memphis, wherever he's at. But he's going to carry himself like a respectable guy. That's what it is. And that's me talking for him because I know every, we have conversations. It is not like I'm an absent father that's saying something I don't know. I'm telling y'all this is who this kid is. Misconstrued? A whole lot. Demonized? A whole lot. Do I hate it? Hell yeah. Do it to me. Don't do it to him. He's not that guy. This dude is gonna be a role model for a while.”

Tee Morant on Ja Morant, Dec 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Ja Morant
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Marcus Smart on Ja Morant:

“Ja is a very special player ... for us to do anything, we're gonna need Ja, and need him to be the best he can be... I like to push guys to the limit ... I did that in Boston with those guys ... I want to have that same relationship with Ja.”

Marcus Smart on Ja Morant, Jul 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Adam Silver on Ja Morant
item.description:
More Adam Silver on Ja Morant:

“I don’t think we yet know what it will take to change his behavior.”

Adam Silver on Ja Morant, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Mike Bass on Ja Morant
item.description:
Adrian Wojnarowski:NBA spokesperson Mike Bass:

“We are aware of the social media post involving Ja Morant and are in the process of gathering more information.”

Mike Bass on Ja Morant, May 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @wojespn.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Dillon Brooks, Ja Morant
item.description:
After all, it made Brooks look like he’s avoiding the consequences of his actions.

“If you’re not going to talk to the media after two straight games, that to me is cowardice. And I don’t believe either [Ja Morant and Dillon Brooks] are cowards… After talking the talk— you can’t avoid the media,”

Richard Jefferson on Dillon Brooks, Ja Morant, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jay Williams on Ja Morant
item.description:
Jay Williams on Ja Morant:

“I do believe the NBA missed the mark on his suspension. I thought he should've been suspended for the rest of the regular season without pay, and his return should have been subject to successful counseling from the NBA.”

Jay Williams on Ja Morant, Mar 24, 2023. Source: reddit.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Ja Morant
item.description:
Taylor Jenkins on if Ja Morant returns Fri:

“There are a lot of internal dialogues going on and obviously there’s still things going on at the league level that we’re in communication with. Ja’s fully engaged in this process and ready for whatever comes next after these 2 games.”

Taylor Jenkins on Ja Morant, Mar 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.
